'''Docking pad RT209''' a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] facility was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] near the [[Imperial Complex (Coruscant)|Imperial Complex]].

==History==
The [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Doriella's Mystress]]'', owned by the [[Rendar family]] and operated by [[RenTrans]], was sabotaged at docking pad RT209 by mechanics under the direction of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. This act resulted in the ''Doriella's Mystress'' crashing into [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] private museum and killing its pilot, [[Stanton Rendar]]. In the wake of this supposed accident, the Rendar family was disgraced, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] was removed from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], and RenTrans underwent a hostile takeover by [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]].
